title: Renal cell carcinoma
subtitle: Two forks decide everything — clear cell vs non-clear cell histology, and IMDC risk. Localized disease is surgical; metastatic clear cell is an IO backbone (IO/IO or IO/TKI) with essentially no predictive biomarker
source: Stanford Oncology Handbook 2025, GU: Renal Cell Carcinoma · NCCN Kidney Cancer · items marked † are outside the handbook chapter

blocks.heading: † Workup
items: CT abdomen/pelvis with contrast (or MRI) defines T stage and venous extension; chest CT for staging. Brain/bone imaging only if symptomatic
Renal mass biopsy is not required before nephrectomy — get it for small masses under surveillance/ablation, suspected lymphoma or metastasis, or before systemic therapy without surgery
Labs feeding IMDC: CBC (Hgb, neutrophils, platelets), calcium, LDH, creatinine, LFTs
Grade (WHO/ISUP) is nucleolar: G1 nucleoli inconspicuous at 400× · G2 conspicuous at 400× · G3 conspicuous at 100× · G4 pleomorphism, giant cells, rhabdoid or sarcomatoid

blocks.heading: Genetics referral (NCCN)
items: ≥1 first- or second-degree relative with RCC
Somatic NGS finds a gene with germline implications (BRCA1/2, Lynch, etc.)

blocks.heading: Staging (AJCC)
rows: Confined to kidney <7 cm — T1a <4 cm, T1b 4–7 cm
Confined to kidney >7 cm — T2a 7–10 cm, T2b >10 cm
Into major veins or perinephric tissue, not beyond Gerota's — a renal vein / pelvicalyceal / sinus fat · b IVC below diaphragm · c IVC above diaphragm or caval wall
Beyond Gerota's fascia, incl. contiguous ipsilateral adrenal
I T1N0 · II T2N0 · III T1–2N1 or T3 any N · IV T4 or any M1

blocks.heading: IMDC risk — 6 factors
blocks.footnote: Favorable = 0 · Intermediate = 1–2 · Poor = ≥3. Three of the six are simple counts — neutrophils, platelets, hemoglobin.

blocks.heading: † Pearls
items: Cytoreductive nephrectomy is no longer routine — CARMENA showed sunitinib alone non-inferior to nephrectomy + sunitinib in int/poor risk. Reserve it for good-performance patients with limited metastatic burden and a large symptomatic primary
Sarcomatoid features carry a poor prognosis but are the one histologic feature that predicts unusually good response to IO — favor ipi/nivo
Bone and brain metastases are common; TKIs do not treat CNS disease — image the brain before starting therapy in symptomatic patients

boxes: T1b–T4: partial if feasible, else radical
ccRCC II G4 ± sarcomatoid or III: adjuvant pembro
Approved across all IMDC risk groups
int/poor: ipi/nivo strongest OS; or cabo alone
ccRCC: sequence by what came before
prior IO: single agents or lenva + everolimus
Non-clear cell: trial is NCCN preferred

blocks.html: No predictive biomarker. PD-L1, TMB and MSI do not select therapy — the only biomarker-directed choices are syndromic. CABOSUN and PAPMET are randomized phase 2, not phase 3.

blocks.heading: Adjuvant and first-line clear cell
rows: Ipi 1 mg/kg IV ×4; nivo 3 mg/kg ×4, then 240 or 480 mg
Lenvatinib 20 mg PO daily; pembro 200 or 400 mg IV
Axitinib 5 mg PO BID; pembro 200 or 400 mg IV
Cabozantinib 40 mg PO daily; nivo 240 or 480 mg IV
Axitinib 5 mg PO BID; avelumab 10 mg/kg IV
800 mg PO daily · 50 mg PO days 1–28
blocks.footnote: IO is capped at 24 months across these regimens. Historical: temsirolimus 25 mg IV weekly (ARCC) and high-dose IL-2 600,000 IU/kg IV q8h days 1–5 and 15–19, inpatient, ORR 14%.

blocks.heading: Later lines and non-clear cell
rows: Lenvatinib 18 mg + everolimus 5 mg PO daily
120 mg PO daily — after IO and VEGF TKI
1.34 mg PO — 3 wk on, 1 wk off, after ≥2 lines
5 mg PO BID → 7 mg BID if BP ≤150/90, max 10 mg BID
Erlotinib 150 mg PO daily; bev 10 mg/kg IV — FH-deficient / HLRCC

blocks.heading: Landmark trials
rows: Adjuvant pembro, high-risk ccRCC — 48-mo DFS 64.9% vs 56.6%, OS 91.2% vs 86% (HR 0.72)
Ipi/nivo vs sunitinib, int/poor — OS 47.0 vs 26.6 mo, CR 11% vs 2%; no benefit in favorable risk
Lenva/pembro — PFS 23.9 vs 9.2 mo, ORR 71.3% vs 36.7% (longest 1L PFS reported)
Axi/pembro OS 46 vs 40 mo · cabo/nivo OS 46.5 vs 36 mo, both vs sunitinib
Belzutifan after IO + TKI — ORR 21.9% vs 3.5%; median PFS 5.6 mo in both arms; OS failed
Tivozanib after ≥2 lines — PFS 5.6 vs 3.9 mo, no OS benefit
Papillary — cabozantinib PFS 9.0 vs 5.6 mo; MET inhibitors failed
Adjuvant sunitinib — DFS 6.8 vs 5.6 yr, no OS benefit

blocks.html: † Surveillance is not in the chapter — NCCN: exam, labs and cross-sectional imaging q3–6 mo ×3 yr after resection of stage II–III, then annually to year 5.
